title: Preventable Death, Longevity & Screening — Bayes' Math, ApoB, Lp(a), CAC & Low-Dose CT

teenKit.tldr: A heart attack isn't a sudden, random event; it's the final chapter of a decades-long biological buildup that starts silently in your youth. Instead of waiting for a 3am emergency, true longevity is about hunting down and stopping these hidden processes years before they cause damage.
teenKit.whyItMatters: Shifting how we look at health from reacting to emergencies to intercepting slow-burning diseases changes the entire future of human lifespan.
keyTakeaways: Disease is a decades-long process, not a sudden event—meaning a heart attack at 52 can trace its roots back to a trapped particle when the person was 20.
Modern medicine spends about 80% of its resources on end-stage organ failure during the final two years of life, treating the damage after it is already done.
True longevity focuses on intercepting the 'four horsemen' of chronic mortality (cardiovascular disease, cancer, neurodegeneration, and metabolic dysfunction) long before symptoms ever appear.
